grades_number_range.name: grades_number_range
grades_number_range.value: ("grades"."stage" = 'fundamental' AND "grades"."number" BETWEEN 1 AND 9) OR ("grades"."stage" = 'medio' AND "grades"."number" BETWEEN 1 AND 3)

flashcards_text_length.name: flashcards_text_length
flashcards_text_length.value: char_length("flashcards"."front") BETWEEN 1 AND 300 AND char_length("flashcards"."back") BETWEEN 1 AND 600

topic_contents_shape.name: topic_contents_shape
topic_contents_shape.value:
("topic_contents"."kind" = 'text' AND "topic_contents"."body_md" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("topic_contents"."kind" = 'video' AND "topic_contents"."url" ~ '^https://')
        OR ("topic_contents"."kind" IN ('table', 'timeline') AND "topic_contents"."data" IS NOT NULL)
